method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: S&P 500: Fresh records with easing stagflation fears – Deutsche Bank
Equities.summary: Deutsche Bank analysts note that the S&P 500 has reached new record highs as stagflation fears eased on lower Oil prices and optimism over a US-Iran deal. The index gained 1.43% last week, marking a ninth consecutive weekly advance, the longest streak sinc
Equities.reason: Broad market-level read: S&P hitting records driven by easing stagflation fears (oil down, US‑Iran negotiation optimism). High relevance for overall equities risk sentiment and positioning.

Equities.title: Stocks shake off Iran jitters as AI rules supreme; oil climbs
Equities.reason: Market wrap highlighting risk‑on tone: geopolitical jitters contained while AI leadership drives markets. Reinforces dominant equity narrative (AI leadership > geopolitical risk) — meaningful but slightly less than primary macro note.

Equities.title: Nvidia unveils PC ‘superchip’ in challenge to Apple and Intel
Equities.summary: Semiconductor paired with Microsoft Windows will allow computers to run AI apps
Equities.reason: Sector-leading structural news: Nvidia expanding addressable market into PCs materially strengthens AI leadership narrative and breadth of tech-led equity rally. Very high relevance for sector and market regime.

Equities.title: Nvidia jumps into PCs with new Arm-based chip debuting in laptops from Microsoft, Dell, HP
Equities.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang unveiled a long-awaited Arm-based PC chip, breaking into PCs for the first time on new laptops by Dell, Microsoft, HP, ASUS and others.
Equities.reason: Product launch broadens Nvidia's TAM and sustains AI leadership momentum. Important for tech sector leadership and investor flows, but more tactical than the FT strategic read.

Equities.title: Japan's Nikkei tops 67,000 on AI boost; SoftBank becomes most valuable Japanese firm
Equities.reason: Regional confirmation of the same AI-led equity regime: Japanese market highs and SoftBank's rally signal global breadth to the AI trade — supportive for broad risk appetite but scope is regional.

Equities.title: Nvidia-backed $5 billion AI company tells CNBC of major London expansion
Equities.summary: Runway follows U.S. AI giants including Anthropic and OpenAI in announcing big London growth plans.
Equities.reason: Illustrates continued investment and geographic expansion in AI ecosystem — reinforces durable demand and funding flows into AI incumbents/adjacencies; positive but company-specific.

Rates.title: Treasury yields edge higher as U.S. and Iran exchange strikes
Rates.summary: Treasury yields rose Monday after the U.S. and Iran exchanged fire near the Strait of Hormuz.
Rates.reason: Geopolitical escalation (US-Iran strikes) has driven an immediate bond selloff in USTs; yields rising is directly negative for Rates. High intraday market impact warrants above-average relevance.

Rates.title: Fed: Later cuts as inflation persists – Rabobank
Rates.summary: Rabobank's Senior US Strategist Philip Marey updates his United States (US) and Federal Reserve (Fed) outlook, highlighting a shift by the FOMC away from an easing bias ahead of Warsh’s first meeting. Marey notes that developments in the Middle East are likely
Rates.reason: Analyst view signalling Fed has pushed back on an easing/cuts timeline as inflation remains persistent — a clear upward pressure on rates (higher-for-longer), material for UST curve pricing.

Rates.title: British Pound: UK faces tighter policy and sticky inflation – BNP Paribas
Rates.summary: BNP Paribas expects UK economic growth to slow to 0.7% in 2026 from 1.4% in 2025, with quarterly momentum dropping to about 0.1%. Inflation is projected to rise to 3.4% before easing only gradually, keeping it above the BoE target.
Rates.reason: Sticky inflation projection implies the Bank of England will maintain tighter policy for longer, pressuring gilt prices / pushing yields higher; relevant for global rates via UK gilt curve.

Rates.title: Japanese bond yields are the highest in 40 years. The budget and a 'red flag' from PM Takaichi have markets nervous
Rates.summary: Japanese bond yields have reached the highest levels in 40 years. The budget and a 'red flag' from Prime Minister Takaichi have made markets nervous.
Rates.reason: Clear report of sustained upward move in JGB yields (40-year highs) tied to fiscal/budgetary concerns — significant domestic rates risk and potential global safe‑haven / carry spillovers.

Rates.title: India Rate Risks, Fiscal Worries Add to Pressure on Bond Yields
Rates.reason: Headline signals sovereign fiscal worries and rate-risk are adding upward pressure to Indian bond yields — relevant for EM rates premia and cross‑border demand/supply in global fixed income.

Rates.title: Chinese Banks’ Net Borrowing Signals Liquidity Glut Is Easing
Rates.reason: Reduced net borrowing implies the prior liquidity surplus is waning, which is likely to push domestic yields higher and tighten global dollar funding conditions — negative for bond prices.

Rates.title: Korea Boosts Bond-Market Vigil Via Daily Phone Calls, Group Chat
Rates.reason: Authorities increasing surveillance/coordination points to stress or volatility in the domestic bond market; signals risk to local yields and potential policy/backstop activity — moderate relevance.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar weakens on risk-off mood, dovish BoC’s tone
FX.summary: USD/CAD extends its gains for the second successive day, trading around 1.3810 during the early European hours on Monday. The pair appreciates as the US Dollar (USD) holds ground on increased safe-haven demand amid US-Iran peace uncertainty.
FX.reason: USD/CAD rally reflects USD safe-haven bid and dovish BoC tone; material for USD/CAD and CAD funding flow narrative (USD strength = negative).

FX.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: Yen languishes amid growing BoJ rate hike uncertainty
FX.summary: The USD/JPY pair trades 0.12% higher at around 159.45 during the early European trading session on Monday. The pair gains as the Japanese Yen (JPY) broadly underperforms amid uncertainty regarding whether the Bank of Japan (BoJ) will raise interest rates in th
FX.reason: BoJ rate-hike uncertainty keeping JPY weak and USD/JPY elevated — important for USD/JPY funding and carry flows (USD strength = negative). Technical forecast emphasis kept relevance moderate-high.

FX.title: Yen Defies Record Intervention as Wait for BOJ Hike Raises Risks
FX.reason: Major FX story: large-scale intervention failing to arrest JPY weakness while BoJ policy timing uncertain — heightened market risk and potential for sustained USD strength vs JPY (high relevance).

FX.title: Euro flat lines near 1.1650 vs USD as ECB hike bets offset hawkish Fed and geopolitics
FX.summary: The EUR/USD pair struggles to capitalize on its recent recovery gains registered over the past two days, from the 1.1585 support zone, and seesaws between tepid gains/minor losses heading into the European session on Monday.
FX.reason: EUR/USD rangebound with ECB/Fed and geopolitics offsetting — small net EUR tone vs USD, limited market-moving signal.

FX.title: Euro: Moves with yields and energy prices against US Dollar – Danske Bank
FX.summary: Danske Research Team notes that EUR/USD ended last week around 1.1650 after a sharp drop in Oil prices, with US and Euro area yields both moving lower. They highlight upcoming United States (US) ISM Manufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI), labor data an
FX.reason: Research note linking EUR moves to yields and energy—useful context for EUR/USD directionality as yields and oil continue to move (moderate relevance).

FX.title: British Pound rises even as BoE’s Bailey signals no rush for interest rate hikes
FX.summary: The British Pound (GBP) trades higher against its major currency peers, but is broadly flat around 1.3455 against the US Dollar (USD), during the European trading session on Monday.
FX.reason: GBP holding gains vs USD despite dovish BoE signalling — central-bank commentary supporting GBP demand vs USD (GBP strength = USD weakness => positive).

FX.title: Australian Dollar softens below 0.7200 amid ongoing Middle East tensions
FX.summary: The AUD/USD pair loses momentum to around 0.7180 during the early European trading hours on Monday. Rising tensions in the Middle East weigh on the riskier assets such as the Australian Dollar (AUD) against the US Dollar (USD).
FX.reason: AUD, a risk-sensitive currency, is weakening on Middle East tensions and safe-haven USD demand — relevant to risk-on/risk-off FX flows (USD strength = negative).

FX.title: Indian Rupee extends advance on US-Iran deal optimism
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) trades firmly against the US Dollar (USD) at the start of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) policy week.
FX.reason: INR gains on US-Iran deal optimism imply broad USD weakness and improved EMFX sentiment — relevant for EM FX flows and RBI-week positioning (USD weakness = positive).

FX.title: United States Dollar Index (DXY) Price Forecast: Hesitation around 99.00
FX.summary: The US Dollar (USD) shows marginal gains on Monday, with risk appetite fading as tensions in the Middle East escalate and oil prices rise.
FX.reason: DXY technical/price-forecast note showing marginal USD gains amid geopolitics; price-forecast format limits relevance but confirms modest USD bid (USD strength = negative).

FX.title: Swiss Franc picks up from session lows following upbeat Swiss data releases
FX.summary: The Swiss Franc (CHF) holds moderate losses against the US Dollar (USD) on Monday, but has bounced up from daily lows, as Swiss Gross Domestic Product (GDP) and Retail Sales Figures pointed to a resilient economy in the face of the Iran war and the energy shoc
FX.reason: Upbeat Swiss data supports CHF vs USD — modest CHF appreciation implies slight USD weakness (CHF strength = USD weakness => positive but limited relevance).

FX.title: NZD/USD Price Forecast: Kiwi corrects lower and tests support at 0.5965
FX.summary: The New Zealand Dollar (NZD) holds marginal losses against the US Dollar (USD) on Monday, retreating to session lows of 0.5965 from highs a few pips below 0.6000.
FX.reason: Technical price-forecast showing NZD correction into support — low-signal technical piece but confirms modest USD bid in risk-off environment.

FX.title: ECB: 12-month forward inflation projections remain steady at 4%
FX.summary: The latest survey by the European Central Bank (ECB) of consumer inflation expectations shows that one-year forward inflation projections remain steady at 4%.
FX.reason: Sticky 1‑yr inflation expectations support the view ECB may stay hawkish relative to the Fed, providing upside bias to EUR vs USD (ECB inflation → EUR support).

Commodities.title: Natural gas for power generation flat this summer, record high expected in 2027

Commodities.reason: EIA official outlook pointing to near-term strength and a record in gas-for-power next year is a meaningful demand-side bullish signal for US natural gas; high relevance given source and multi-season forecast.

Commodities.title: Most planned natural gas pipeline capacity additions in 2026 and 2027 originate in Texas
Commodities.summary: Developers plan to bring approximately 44.9 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d) of new pipeline capacity online in the United States in 2026 and 2027, according to our latest Natural Gas Pipeline Projects Tracker. Approximately 70% (31.6 Bcf/d) of this new capa
Commodities.reason: Planned large pipeline additions (44.9 Bcf/d) point to meaningful capacity/supply-side expansion that should weigh on regional gas tightness; offsets some demand-driven bullishness—important structural supply signal.

Commodities.title: WTI Oil returns above $89.00 as tensions in the Middle East rise
Commodities.summary: Crude prices are trading higher on Monday, with the barrel of the US benchmark West Texas Intermediate (WTI) changing hands at $89.40 at the time of writing, nearly $3 higher than last week’s closing price.
Commodities.reason: Middle East escalation is a clear upside risk for crude via supply disruption / risk premium; short-term market-moving geopolitical driver with high relevance to oil prices.

Commodities.title: Oil: Hormuz disruption keeps market strained – Societe Generale
Commodities.summary: Societe Generale’s Michael Haigh and Jeremy Sellem argue that the proposed U.S–Iran ceasefire framework would only gradually restore flows through the Strait of Hormuz, keeping Oil markets tight.
Commodities.reason: Analyst view that Strait of Hormuz flows will be slow to normalize supports a sustained supply-risk premium for oil; reinforces the dominant geopolitical-driven tightness narrative.

Commodities.title: Oil prices climb over 3% as U.S.-Iran talks at impasse, Israel expands Lebanon offensive
Commodities.summary: Oil prices rose on Monday after Israel instructed troops to push deeper into Lebanon amid renewed clashes with the Iran-backed Hezbollah group.
Commodities.reason: News of intensified regional conflict is driving a near-term oil price rally; CNBC report is a high-profile confirmation of the same geopolitics-driven tightening theme.

Commodities.title: Oil exports through the Strait of Hormuz might not return to levels seen before the Iran war
Commodities.summary: Iran's blockade of the Strait of Hormuz has seriously challenged freedom of navigation in the sea lane, raising questions about the future.
Commodities.reason: Persistent structural reduction in flows via Hormuz would be a lasting supply constraint for seaborne crude — a significant bullish structural signal for oil markets.

Commodities.title: Gold falls below $4,500 as geopolitics and hawkish Fed lift USD, reinforcing bearish setup
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) extends its steady intraday descent through the first half of the European session and retreats further from the vicinity of the $4,600 mark, or a two-week high set on Friday.
Commodities.reason: USD strength and hawkish Fed expectations are classic headwinds for gold; FXStreet price action confirms weaker demand for bullion amid higher real-rate expectations.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD rises to near $75.70 on US-Iran deal hopes
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) is up 0.5% to near $75.75 during the European trading session on Monday. The white metal trades higher amid hopes that the United States (US) and Iran will reach a permanent peace deal soon.
Commodities.reason: Intraday price/forecast piece: silver is nudged higher on geopolitical peace hopes — limited relevance as a short-term price note rather than a structural driver.

Commodities.title: The regional differences in gasoline prices this Memorial Day
Commodities.summary: Against the backdrop of a nationwide increase in gasoline prices, regional dynamics including local supply and demand conditions, state fuel specifications, and state taxes influence the different prices drivers see at the pump.
Commodities.reason: EIA analysis noting a nationwide rise in gasoline prices with regional drivers — relevant to RBOB/gasoline market structure but a localized/seasonal pricing note with modest market impact.

Commodities.title: Copper Gains With US Tariffs Deadline Less Than a Month Away
Commodities.reason: Copper moving higher ahead of a US tariffs deadline suggests demand/flow considerations and potential policy-driven upside; relevant to base metals but not an overwhelming structural shift.

Commodities.title: The United States is a major energy exporter and importer, especially for petroleum
Commodities.summary: Total energy exports from the United States reached a record 31 quadrillion British thermal units (quads) in 2025, 2% more than the previous record set in 2024. U.S. energy imports were 21 quads, down 5% from 2024. Taken together, net trade—total imports less
Commodities.reason: Record US energy exports imply stronger flows from the US into global markets and larger available supply — a modest bearish structural influence on global hydrocarbon prices.

Crypto.title: Citi predicts the tokenized securities market will grow to $5.5 trillion by 2030
Crypto.reason: Large institutional forecast for tokenization supports long-term institutional adoption and new on-chain product demand — net bullish for crypto infrastructure and tokenized-asset growth.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin extends slide as spot ETF outflows hit a record while Wall Street rips on AI
Crypto.reason: Record spot-ETF outflows and BTC price weakness are a direct negative signal for crypto liquidity and institutional demand, weighing heavily on market sentiment.

Crypto.title: How Stellar became part of DTCC's tokenization push for Wall Street securities onchain
Crypto.reason: DTCC engagement with Stellar signals concrete institutional integration of tokenization rails — constructive for crypto infrastructure and institutional usage.

Crypto.title: SEC sues Texas man over $12.3 million alleged crypto scheme built on fake AI trading bots
Crypto.reason: Enforcement action highlights fraud/legal risks in crypto, reinforcing regulatory scrutiny and short-term trust erosion among investors.

Crypto.title: XRP ETFs add $35 million as bitcoin and ether funds lost $2 billion in late May
Crypto.reason: Small net inflows into XRP ETFs alongside sizable BTC/ETH outflows point to rotation within crypto but overall weaker ETF demand — modestly negative for market breadth.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin, ether, XRP, dogecoin lag a nine-week stocks rally as ETF demand cools
Crypto.reason: Crypto underperformance versus equities and cooling ETF demand reinforce a risk-off/flow-scare narrative that depresses prices across major tokens.

Crypto.title: U.S. regulator says 24/7 trading is great for crypto, may not be fit for other sectors
Crypto.reason: Regulator endorsement of crypto-native market structure (24/7 trading) is a positive signal for market infrastructure and product suitability.

Crypto.title: Three Sui mainnet halts in 48 hours traced to an upgrade bug by developers
Crypto.reason: Repeated mainnet halts from an upgrade bug raise technical and counterparty risks for Layer-1 projects, worsening risk sentiment around protocol reliability.

Crypto.title: Aave overhauls listing standards after $230 million rsETH exploit exposed bridge risks
Crypto.reason: Large exploit underscores ongoing smart-contract/bridge vulnerabilities; protocol-level fixes are constructive but near-term confidence takes a hit.

Crypto.title: A massive $1.26 billion sale of BlackRock’s IBIT was likely a rapid exit by a large investor
Crypto.reason: A very large, rapid sale of a major institutional BTC product signals acute liquidity stress and is a significant negative for institutional ETF flows and prices.

Crypto.title: U.S. says it seized about $1 billion in Iranian crypto as pressure campaign expands
Crypto.reason: High-profile seizure demonstrates law-enforcement capabilities on-chain; while geopolitically charged, it can strengthen market integrity and regulatory credibility.

Crypto.title: Wall Street’s trillion-dollar dilemma: Why AI-powered hackers are keeping big banks off the blockchain
Crypto.reason: Persistent DeFi exploits and rising AI-enabled attack risk are a material barrier to TradFi adoption, weighing on prospects for institutional integration.

Crypto.title: ‘The banks will not accept it’: Dimon escalates battle over stablecoin rewards in CLARITY Act debate
Crypto.reason: High-profile political and banking resistance to stablecoin policy provisions increases regulatory risk around stablecoin incentives and banking integration.
